title.en: Meta adds customizable spaces to the Muse app
title.zhHans: Meta 为 Muse 应用增加可自定义的 Spaces

searchSummary.en: Meta said on November 6 that Muse users could create personalized spaces through descriptions; outside usage has not been measured.
searchSummary.zhHans: Meta 于 11 月 6 日称 Muse 用户可通过描述创建个性化 Spaces；外部使用规模尚无测量。

summary.en: Meta announced Spaces in Muse on November 6: users can describe and rearrange personalized app experiences such as planners or trackers. Meta said Spaces were available wherever Muse itself was available. A separate report describes the launch but does not independently test background updating or adoption. This action is distinct from the November 5 voice and avatar rollout; shared workspaces and broader collaboration remain future exploration.
summary.zhHans: Meta 于 11 月 6 日宣布 Muse 应用的 Spaces 功能：用户可通过文字描述创建日程或追踪工具等个性化界面，并调整其位置。Meta 称该功能在 Muse 已提供服务的地区可用。另一篇报道描述了发布，但没有独立测试后台更新或采用规模。这与 11 月 5 日的语音和动态形象推送不同；共享空间与更广泛的协作仍属未来探索。

narrative.en: The dated action is a consumer customization feature, not a new foundation model, proof that every user has built a space or evidence that merchants already benefit from it. Vendor examples are possibilities, not measured outcomes.
narrative.zhHans: 事件是消费应用自定义功能的发布，不是新的基础模型，也不证明每位用户都已创建空间或商家已有实际收益。厂商举例属于可能用途，并非已测量的成效。

text.en: Meta announced on November 6 that Spaces could be created and used wherever the Muse app was available.
text.zhHans: Meta 于 11 月 6 日宣布，用户可创建 Spaces，服务范围限于 Muse 应用已开放的地区。

text.en: Shared Spaces are only being explored; there is no independently measured uptake or verified background-update reliability here.
text.zhHans: 共享 Spaces 仍处探索阶段；本轮未取得独立测量的采用量或已验证的后台更新可靠性。
